title: DesktopResultPayloadV1
description: The closed set of result payloads the five Phase-01 desktop operations return. Each is a closed object carrying shell facts only.
$comment: ResponseEnvelope لا يحمل حقل operation، فلا يستطيع المخطط وحده ربط النتيجة بعمليتها. الربط يقع على البوابة عبر request_id والسجل، وهذا حدّ مُعلن في PHASE-01-IPC-CONTRACTS.md لا ثغرة مسكوت عنها. وDesktopBootstrapResultV1 مرجع مجرّد بلا حقول مجاورة عمدًا: $ref ومعه title أو description يُفقد مُفكِّك المراجع قاعدةَ العنوان فتنكسر المراجع الداخلية للوثيقة المُشار إليها. الشرح مكانه الوثيقة لا المخطط.

observed_at.description: When the host observed this. The shell caches status as a query result with an explicit staleness story, and cannot tell a stale answer from a fresh one without this.

capabilities.description: One entry per capability the request named. A capability the host does not know is answered UNAVAILABLE with a reason, never omitted silently.

DesktopSettingsDescribeResultV1.title: DesktopSettingsDescribeResultV1
DesktopSettingsDescribeResultV1.description: Structure and per-setting mode. No value of any kind appears in a describe result.

DesktopSettingsReadResultV1.title: DesktopSettingsReadResultV1
DesktopSettingsReadResultV1.description: Resolved, display-safe values for one section. A secret-bearing setting is reported as configured and its value is withheld.
